reference.scope: Actual Godot Skeleton3D solved matrices and actual constructed ArrayMesh readback position/bone/weight arrays with package inverse binds, compared to independent live Three skinning reference; not rendered/GPU evidence
reference.tolerance_reason: Standard ArrayMesh skin weights are packed to 16-bit. The earlier 2e-6 raw-float limit failed at 2.5113e-5 actual readback error; retained in failure logs. This explicit limit is 0.0175 mm only under the chosen 0.35m/sourceunit scene scale, not a claim of byte-identical skinning. Body matrix mapping is checked separately at 2e-6.

scope: Actual whole selected character plus true skinned local hand candidate rendered on GPU; close images explicitly isolate hand. Not final anatomy, collision or grasp acceptance
